# Hooks (C3.9): each hook appends what it sees to @log, so the order of the hooks and the
# values their formats expand to are compared with tmux's. run-shell comes with C3.10; the
# hooks here log with set -gaF.
size 80x24
run new-session -d -s h -n w 'exec cat'
run set -s focus-events on
run set-hook -g after-split-window "set -gaF @log 'after-split-window:#{pane_id}:#{hook_flag_t}:#{hook_argument_0}:#{hook}|'"
run set-hook -g after-kill-pane "set -gaF @log 'after-kill-pane:#{pane_id}:#{hook_arguments}|'"
run set-hook -g after-new-window "set -gaF @log 'after-new-window:#{window_index}.#{pane_index}|'"
run set-hook -g after-select-pane "set -gaF @log 'after-select-pane:#{pane_id}|'"
run set-hook -g window-pane-changed "set -gaF @log 'window-pane-changed:#{pane_id}:#{hook_pane}:#{hook_new_pane}:#{hook_old_pane}:#{hook_window_name}|'"
run set-hook -g pane-exited "set -gaF @log 'pane-exited:#{hook_pane}:#{hook_exit_status}:#{hook_exit_success}|'"
run set-hook -g pane-died "set -gaF @log 'pane-died:#{pane_id}:#{pane_dead}:#{pane_dead_status}:#{hook_exit_status}|'"
run set-hook -g pane-focus-in "set -gaF @log 'pane-focus-in:#{pane_id}:#{hook_pane}|'"
run set-hook -g pane-focus-out "set -gaF @log 'pane-focus-out:#{hook_pane}|'"
run set-hook -g client-attached "set -gaF @log 'client-attached:#{session_name}:#{hook_session_name}:#{pane_id}|'"
run show-hooks -g
run show-hooks -g after-split-window
# Split, select and kill: the after- hooks run at once, window-pane-changed after the list.
run split-window -t h 'exec cat' ; set -gaF @log 'list-end|'
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run split-window -d -h -t h:w.0 'exec cat' ; show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run select-pane -t h:w.0 ; select-pane -t h:w.0
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run kill-pane -t h:w.1
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run new-window -t h -n x 'exec cat' ; select-window -t h:w
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
# A hook's own commands fire no hooks.
run set-hook -g after-select-window "select-pane -t h:w.0 ; set -gaF @log 'after-select-window:#{window_index}|'"
run select-window -t h:x ; select-window -t h:w
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log '' ; set-hook -gu after-select-window
# An attached client: client-attached, and focus following the active pane.
client c1 80x24
wait '#{!=:#{@log},}' == 1
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run select-pane -t h:w.1
wait '#{!=:#{@log},}' == 1
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
# A pane's program ends: pane-exited, or with remain-on-exit pane-died, and the pane stays.
run split-window -d -t h:x 'sleep 0.2; exit 3'
wait '#{m:*pane-exited*,#{@log}}' == 1
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run set -g remain-on-exit on ; split-window -d -t h:x 'sleep 0.2; exit 4'
wait '#{m:*pane-died*,#{@log}}' == 1
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run lsp -t h:x -F '#{pane_index} #{pane_dead} #{pane_dead_status}'
run set -g remain-on-exit failed ; split-window -d -t h:x 'sleep 0.2; exit 0'
wait '#{m:*pane-exited*,#{@log}}' == 1
run show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
# set-hook -R runs a hook now; -u and arrays.
run set-hook -R after-kill-pane ; show -gv @log ; set -g @log ''
run set-hook -ga after-kill-pane "set -gaF @log 'second|'" ; show-hooks -g after-kill-pane
run set-hook -gu after-kill-pane ; show-hooks -g after-kill-pane
run set-hook -g nonsense 'x'
run set-hook -g after-kill-pane 'nonsense-command'
run set-hook
run kill-server
